# PowerColor Expands RDNA™ 4 Lineup with the New AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT Graphics Cards

New Additions to HELLHOUND, HELLHOUND SPECTRAL WHITE, and REAPER Series for 1440p Gaming

TAIPEI, TAIWAN June 4 th, 2025– PowerColor, a leading innovator in the graphics card industry, proudly announces its AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT graphics card lineup, designed to deliver outstanding 1440p gaming performance with efficient cooling, premium engineering, and sleek aesthetics. The new additions—HELLHOUND, HELLHOUND SPECTRAL WHITE, and REAPER models—bring advanced performance and cooling features to a wider audience, continuing PowerColor’s commitment to excellence across every price segment.

### HELLHOUND Series – Precision, Silence, and Power

The PowerColor HELLHOUND AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT carries forward the same acclaimed DNA as its 9070 XT sibling. Featuring a robust triple-fan cooler in a dual-slot design, it ensures optimal thermal performance while maintaining a whisper-quiet operation.

With a Game Clock of 2740MHz and a Boost Clock of 3310MHz (OC mode), the card is engineered to tackle demanding titles at 1440p with ease. Equipped with Honeywell PTM7950 thermal pads, the HELLHOUND maximizes heat transfer for sustained performance under load.

A signature Icy Blue LED illumination—which can be toggled on or off via a physical switch—adds a cool visual edge to the card. The HELLHOUND also includes Dual BIOS functionality, allowing users to easily switch between Silent and OC modes to suit their gaming or thermal preferences.

Available in both 16GB and 8GB GDDR6 configurations, the HELLHOUND offers flexibility without compromising on quality or design.

### HELLHOUND SPECTRAL WHITE – Where Elegance Meets Performance 

For gamers who crave performance in a refined, clean aesthetic, PowerColor introduces the HELLHOUND SPECTRAL WHITE AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT 16GB. This model features a fully white-themed design, from PCB to heatsink and cooler components, delivering a unified and striking appearance.

| | Built on the same high-performance architecture as its standard HELLHOUND counterpart, the SPECTRAL WHITE offers identical clock speeds (2740MHz Game / 3310MHz Boost) and the same triple-fan cooling solution, along with Honeywell PTM7950 thermal pads for optimal thermal control. |
| --- | --- |

| Icy White LEDs—toggled via an onboard switch—enhance the clean design with a touch of glowing elegance. The HELLHOUND SPECTRAL WHITE also supports Dual BIOS, providing the flexibility to toggle between performance and quiet profiles as needed. Available exclusively in the 16GB configuration, it’s the go-to choice for gamers who want performance wrapped in sophistication. | |
| --- | --- |

### REAPER Series – Compact Performance Unleashed

The REAPER AMD Radeon™ RX 9060 XT, available in both 16GB and 8GB models, is the perfect fit for small form factor systems without sacrificing performance. Measuring just 220mm in length, the dual-fan cooled design is built for efficiency and quiet operation.

| | With a Game Clock up to 2620MHz and a Boost Clock up to 3230MHz, REAPER ensures high-frame-rate gaming in compact setups. Built using Honeywell PTM7950 thermal pads, it offers excellent thermal conductivity and long-term reliability. |
| --- | --- |

| The REAPER’s understated design, powerful specs, and space-saving form factor make it the ideal GPU for compact gaming rigs and value-driven enthusiasts. | |
| --- | --- |

---

Title: PowerColor unveils its RX 9060 XT range - OC3D
URL: https://overclock3d.net/news/gpu-displays/powercolor-unveils-its-rx-9060-xt-range/
Published: 2025-06-02T14:59:26.000Z
Author: Mark Campbell
Highlights:
PowerColor has officially revealed its Radeon RX 9060 XT range of graphics cards, confirming the clock speeds and specifications of all of its models. In total, the company will be releasing five RX 9060 XT series GPU models. Most of these models will feature factory overclocks, with the only exception being the RX 9060 XT Reaper 8GB.

(RX 9060 XT Reaper)

PowerColor’s RX 9060 XT range can be split into the company’s Hellhound and Reaper product lines. PowerColor’s RX 9060 Reaper features a two-fan cooling solution and will be available in 8GB and 16GB forms. The RX 9060 XT Hellhound features a 3-fan cooler and will be available in 16GB and 8GB forms. Note that the 16GB RX 9060 XT Hellhound will be available in (standard) black and Spectral White.

All of PowerColor’s RX 9060 XT models will be powered using a single 8-pin PCIe power connector. All models also feature three display outputs. This includes two DisplayPort outputs and one HDMI 2.1 output.

...

## PowerColor RX 9060 XT Series Specifications

Most of PowerColor’s RX 9060 XT range features a significant factory overclock over AMD’s reference clock speeds. Only PowerColor’s baseline RX 9060 XT Reaper 8GB model features AMD’s reference clock speeds. Note that this GPU’s 16GB model features a boost clock speed that is 100 MHz higher than AMD’s reference speeds.

In OC mode, PowerColor’s Hellhound RX 9060 XT GPUs feature “Game” clock speeds that are 210 MHz higher than AMD’s reference speeds. That’s an 8.3% increase in clock speed over AMD’s reference specifications.

## Pricing and availability

AMD’s Radeon RX 9060 XT will become available on June 5th. Sadly, PowerColor has not unveiled the pricing of its newest RDNA 4 products. AMD has set the MSRP of its 8GB RX 9060 XT at $299. The 16GB model has a suggested retail price (MSRP) of $349. We expect PowerColor’s Reaper series GPUs to target AMD’s MSRP price, and their Hellhound series GPUs to be priced slightly higher. AMD has no plans to release an MBA (Made by AMD) Radeon RX 9060 XT GPU model.

Author: N/A
Highlights:
CFD販売は、「PowerColor」ブランドより、ビデオカード「Radeon RX 9060 XT」シリーズ4製品の取り扱いを開始し、6月6日に発売した。ラインアップとして、「RX9060XT 16G-L/OC」「RX9060XT 8G-L/OC」「RX9060XT 16G-A」「RX9060XT 8G-A」の4モデルを用意する。

Highlights:
We have an update from another board partner on the upcoming RX 9060 XT graphics cards.

First, we have photos of the new white models based on the Reaper and Hellhound designs. It’s not yet clear whether they are launching alongside the original black models, but they appear to be mirrored designs with a white aesthetic.

In total, we know that PowerColor is working on seven Radeon RX 9060 XT cards, featuring Hellhound and Reaper designs in both white and black. The Hellhound Spectral White seems to be available only with 16GB of memory. All cards use a dual-slot design and have three display connectors.

One thing we noticed is that Yeston’s RX 9060 XT GAEA, which is the Chinese board partner’s MSRP model, has different clock speeds for the 16GB and 8GB versions. At the time, we thought this might be the only card with such a difference. It turns out that PowerColor’s Reaper model, which is also an MSRP card, will feature different clock speeds. There is a 90 to 100 MHz difference (game/boost) between the 8GB and 16GB variants. We’ve included all clock speeds in the table below, along with new photos.
